{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the number of unique sites
unique_sites = df_dedup['site'].unique()
print(f'Unique sites after deduplication: {unique_sites}')
print(f'Number of unique sites: {len(unique_sites)}')"}
